title: Remove Internet Identity login/signup prompts and keep admin routes access-denied for anonymous users

requirements.summary: Ensure core routes (/, /history, /report/$reportId) remain usable for anonymous users without redirects or Internet Identity prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: When not authenticated with Internet Identity (no identity present), the user can navigate to "/" and create a report without seeing any login/signup-required screen.
When not authenticated with Internet Identity, the user can navigate to "/history" and view the history screen without seeing any login/signup-required screen.
When not authenticated with Internet Identity, the user can navigate to a valid "/report/$reportId" URL and view the report detail screen without seeing any login/signup-required screen.
No UI copy on the core routes instructs the user to sign in with Internet Identity.

file_operations.description: Audit and ensure routing/guards only restrict admin routes; confirm no global auth gate is applied to core routes, and keep anonymous access unblocked for /, /history, and /report/$reportId.
Ensure anonymous report creation flow does not trigger or suggest any Internet Identity login/signup UI; handle createReport errors with non-auth, non-Internet-Identity messaging on the page.
Ensure anonymous users can view history without any login/signup-required UI; verify empty/loading/error states do not mention Internet Identity.
Ensure anonymous users can view report details without any login/signup-required UI; verify error states do not mention Internet Identity.

requirements.summary: Remove Internet Identity login/signup UX from the UI and eliminate any triggers for useInternetIdentity().login() in normal app navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: There is no navigation path in the UI that leads to an Internet Identity login screen.
No visible button/CTA in the app triggers `useInternetIdentity().login()`.
All user-facing text that mentions “Internet Identity” is removed from screens reachable through normal app navigation.

file_operations.description: Remove the Internet Identity login screen component entirely to prevent any possibility of rendering, linking, or invoking Internet Identity login from the UI.

Audit header navigation for any sign-in related CTAs or Internet Identity references; ensure no UI control triggers `useInternetIdentity().login()` and no visible copy mentions Internet Identity. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Audit layout-level banners/containers to ensure no login/signup-required wrappers or Internet Identity references are introduced around routed content; keep core pages reachable without auth prompts.

requirements.summary: Keep /admin/users protected for anonymous users by showing an access denied screen (not a login/signup prompt) and keep admin nav hidden unless admin status is confirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: When not authenticated with Internet Identity, visiting "/admin/users" shows AccessDeniedScreen.
Anonymous users do not see any Internet Identity login prompt when attempting to access admin routes.
Admin navigation items remain hidden unless admin status is positively confirmed.

file_operations.description: Maintain the existing AdminRouteGuard behavior: if no identity is present, render AccessDeniedScreen (never LoginScreen); if admin status is not positively confirmed, render AccessDeniedScreen.
Verify AccessDeniedScreen messaging remains neutral (no sign-in/signup prompts, no Internet Identity references) and continues to provide a safe navigation option back to '/'.
Ensure admin navigation items remain hidden unless admin status is positively confirmed (do not infer admin from authentication alone). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure any unauthorized/anonymous access results in AccessDeniedScreen and never a login/signup prompt; remove any dead/unused auth-related logic that could surface Internet Identity UI text indirectly.
